variant_remarks.quote: ‏ وأبو قيس الأودي اسمه عبد الرحمن بن ثروان الكوفي وقد رواه شعبة عن أبي قيس ‏

notes: needs_ruling (rule 11, narrated encounter): the saying is Abdullah ibn Masud's ruling inside a story where Abu Musa, Salman and Abdullah speak; not settled whether Abdullah is the last link or only in the scene, so the chain stops at هزيل
«وقد رواه شعبة عن أبي قيس» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«قال أبو عيسى هذا حديث حسن» and «اسمه عبد الرحمن بن ثروان» are compiler remarks, left out

rule 11, narrated encounter: «جاء رجل إلى أبي موسى وسلمان بن ربيعة» and «قال عبد الله»: Abu Musa, Salman and Abdullah speak and act inside Hudhayl's account; they are not written as links; whether the report has them as sources or only in the scene is unsettled
the Prophet's ruling «كما قضى رسول الله» ends Abdullah's words; the Prophet is the end, not a link
